text: Michael Petruskey is a Iron Master Ithaeur member of the Whispers pack in Chicago.
The is a submachine gun that appears in Call of Duty 2 and that was originally stated to appear in Call of Duty: World at War, but was cut in early production stages.
Molly 8, born as Ellen Conlynne, is 12th generation Tzimisce, a Necromancer and Necronomist within her clan. She is a member of the Librarians, a coven of Montréal.
Moe Stimple is a Homid Ahroun Bone Gnawer. He appears in Rage. He works as a bartender for the Ragnarok Casino and gets into a fight with Fireclaw.

Mike Branson is a twelfth generation Nosferatu and the sire of Elena the Butterfly. He was the boss of Elena's abusive boyfriend who sent her to satisfy his master on occasion, turning her into his ghoul. When Elena got tired of her boyfriend's mistreatment, Mike embraced her.
The is a bullpup submachine gun featured in many games of the Modern Warfare series, as well as in Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Mobile. It is also briefly seen in Call of Duty: Ghosts.

Misha is a Malkavian of Eastern Europe who became possessed by the powerful Tzimisce Yorska. Yorska has Misha's aura, but thanks to his rituals, retains all his characteristics and disciplines. The real body of Yorska is carefully guarded and lies in the Carpathians. If its current shell is destroyed, the spirit will return to its real body. Misha's appearance is tangled, shoulder-length straw-blond hair, a goatee, crazy eyes. Yorksa suffers from the Malkavian's clan curse and the wildest conspiracy theories swarm in his head, and the Tzimisce himself falls into mania, then depression, and this interferes with Yorsky's perfectionism.
Milivoje Dobrosavic is (or was) a Serbian Tzimisce and, apparently, a Noddist scholar.
Moses "Coyote" Delgado is an Unseelie coyote Pooka Grump in the Kingdom of the Burning Sun.

The (German for Tank Terror) is an anti-tank rocket launcher, used by the Wehrmacht. The Panzerschreck appears in almost all WWII era Call of Duty installments, barring the first game. It is mainly used for eliminating tanks, but can also be used as an anti-personnel weapon to some effect due to its ability to cause high amounts of damage.
Moonchaser was a homid Wendigo Theurge who lived in the 19th century United States.
Muhammad-Shafi was an Ashirra vampire of the Abrek free state in Chechnya. He was the son by birth and childe of Imam Shamil.
Mu’tazz Bechara is a 12th Generation Country Gangrel. He is one of several Ready-Made Player Characters found in V20 Ready Made Characters.

The Lockheed P-38 Lightning is an American fighter aircraft used in World War II. The P-38 was capable of fulfilling multiple roles including dive bombing, level bombing, ground-attack, photo reconnaissance and as a long-range fighter escort. It is seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One, Call of Duty: World at War and Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS).
Monday is a Red Talon Werewolf introduced in the Werewolf: The Apocalypse expansion of Vampire: The Masquerade - Rivals, Fang & Talon.

The sire of Mowgli was a tenth generation Gangrel antitribu of Pennsylvania. In 1830, the crazed Gangrel Embraced him in the mines and abandoned him. Mowgli survived his first nights by retreating into the deep mine shafts and learning to feed on solitary miners, enduring the rage and loneliness caused by his Embrace. He eventually turned his attention toward destroying his sire. Mowgli convinced the miners that a rich coal vein lay beneath the caverns used as his sire's haven. After two days of blasting, he entered the tunnels and found his sire crushed beneath rubble and in torpor. In a sudden rage, he committed diablerie upon her.
Dr. Nancy Reage is a vampire of the Malkavian clan, a research assistant to her well-known sire, Dr. Douglas Netchurch.
The (Panzerkampfwagen IV or abbreviated PzKpfw IV) is a medium tank considered to be the workhorse of the Wehrmacht, that is fielded by the Axis during World War II.

Muse is an 11th generation Daughter of Cacophony and member of the Les Misérables Sabbat pack in Montréal. A servant of the demon Metathiax, she hums a song to keep the bestial creatures of her lord in check – and is secretly guarded by Leperhead, the Black Spiral Dancer.
Myrddin is a Legendary Kinain Mage of Cymru, the land mortals call Wales.
Murid Hajio was an Ashirra vampire of the Abrek free state in Chechnya. He was the childe of Imam Shamil and confident of Ghazi Muhammad.

The is a disposable anti-tank weapon featured in Call of Duty, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and Call of Duty: Vanguard. It also makes brief cameo appearances in Call of Duty: World at War and Call of Duty: WWII, and was cut from Call of Duty 2.
Night Horrors: Count Fucking Dracula is a character profile for Count Dracula, a Gangrel from .

Nicola Michaud was a Parisian whose parents were targeted by the Nazi occupation during World War II. Michaud eventually went on the run, documenting all that he experienced with the pen his father had bought him in childhood. At some point during his travails, his pen awoke as a spirit and drove him further in his recordings — especially as he collected the names of every collaborator he could find, a list that would find its way to the most vicious of the resistance's leaders.

Noel is a ninth generation Quebecois Toreador Anarch and the childe of the famous Victoria Ash. Like many before him, Noel fell in love with his sire before she abandoned him. Years after, Noel was still in love with Victoria, hiding his Quebec French accent in conversations as she didn't like it.

The is an American single-seat long-range fighter produced during World War II, featured in Call of Duty: Finest Hour, Call of Duty 2, and Call of Duty: World at War. The P-51 saw service with various Allied air forces in the North African, Mediterranean and Italian theatres, and saw limited service against the Japanese in the Pacific Theater.
Nojus was a Kindred elder and reputed scholar of Lithuania, during the Dark Ages. He was brutally destroyed for challenging the Tzimisce Gabija.
Octavia is an Ananasi of the Kumoti aspect, and a resident of Rio de Janeiro.

Obatala (aw-bah-tah-lah) is an Orisha; a younger son of the supreme orisha Olorun. It is he who designed the world, fashioning it and all its creatures, including humans, from the sky, void, and water of the primal universe. Also called Orisha-Nla.
Private Pavel Semenov (Russian: Павел Семенов) was a young Soviet soldier who served in the 13th Guards Rifle Division during the Battle of Stalingrad.

Obol was a demon active in Istanbul in 1509. A Psychopomp who once collected dead souls for the God-Machine, Obol was hired by Shahinji, the Falconer, to design a ritual to banish a vengeful ghost whose identity the Falconer had once used as a Cover.
Old Storm Chaser is a Red Talon Theurge Master of the Challenge, Master of the Rite and Gatekeeper of the Sept of the Weeping Daughter. He is old and considered wise and very connected to Gaia.
Ossian, son of Bane Slayer was a Homid Ahroun Fianna who lived during the Dark Ages. Despite being a warrior, his poetry was the envy of every Galliard in Ireland.

The PTRS-41 is a gas-operated, anti-tank rifle that was originally used by the Soviet Armed Forces during World War II. It appears in Call of Duty as a mounted weapon and later reappears in Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard as a portable sniper rifle.
Osric is an eighth generation Nosferatu of New England and the sire of Prudence Stone. He saved a young Prudence from being executed for witchcraft due to her foresight talents and Embraced the girl.
Olena is an ambitious Tremere Apprentice of the Dark Ages. She was part of the coterie put together by Jervais to enter Livonia and destroy the Telyavelic Tremere.
Wraiths are creatures of emotion, fed by the energy of emotion, Pathos. To acquire Pathos, wraiths must feel Passions, emotions intimately connected to their identity.

The P-47 Thunderbolt is an American fighter-bomber aircraft produced during World War II. The P-47 was very effective in air-combat but proved especially adept at ground-attack. The P-47 appears in Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 2: Big Red One, Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty: Roads to Victory, Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts and Call of Duty: WWII.

Patience Boswell is a prominent Toreador of Seattle. They can usually be found at Aurora Pawn in a back room. They train Phyre in Toreador disciplines. Patience is a Seattle native and an artist in mortal life, embraced into the local Camarilla by a Toreador. The Toreador quickly disregarded them for apparent lack of talent. Patience doesnt care about politics, keeping busy with their unique art. The Anarch leader Katsumi Ishizaki supplies Patience with items.
Phantomas, born as Varros Dominus but also known as the Phantom of the Opera, is a sixth generation Nosferatu. He killed his sire, Urgahalt.

Petrus was a member of the Order of Hermes (house not stated) and a former colleague of Reginald Wojcik. The two of them trained together, and so when Wojcik became a Nephandus, the Order asked Petrus to oversee the operation to bring him in. Petrus delegated most of the legwork to Zydeco Jones and Card Farrel (and later, Ozymandias Cody) while he operated in the background, feeding them information through a series of dead drops located in isolated desert mailboxes. When Cody complained of the strain the work was causing to his marriage, Petrus blithely advised him to leave his wife; Cody noted at the time that Petrus spend more time in various Horizon Realms than on Earth. Petrus disappeared into the Umbra while attempting to travel through the Gauntlet to his home in Crete after the Avatar Storm.

The tank (also known as the Panzer V and Sd.Kfz. 171) was a medium tank fielded by Nazi Germany in World War II. It physically appears in Call of Duty 3 and Call of Duty: World at War. It was cut from Call of Duty 2, appears as a photograph in Call of Duty: Finest Hour and appears as a Data Vault entry in Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

Pierre Gedou was a ghoul of Toreador Justicar Madame Guil in the late 1990s, widely known as her hatchetman. Through the years, he perfected the art of murder and death. Rumor had it that he would bury vampires alive after he drained all of their blood, leaving them there to rot and go mad. His fate is unknown.

Phaedra was one of the Kindred, and sister to Miranda Corliss (whether biological or not is unknown, particularly as Corliss had called her sire "father"). An ambitious woman, Phaedra plotted to seize power from her sire the Prince, much to Corliss's fury. When Corliss let in one of the Striges to stop Phaedra, the Owl used her body to wreak havoc, including nearly causing the Prince's death. Phaedra promptly used that opportunity to maneuver herself into power.

Porthos Fitz-Empress was an Archmage. He was a signature character of the Order of Hermes and a member of the Cabal of the Druo'shi, the Seekers of Truth, in the chantry of Doissetep. Porthos was created by Stephen C. Brown and Phil Brucato.

The is a submachine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). It sports a medium-high rate of fire and very low recoil, but low damage, though it is always a one hit kill if headshot. It is found in later levels of the campaign and in Multiplayer is unlocked after 150 kills with the MAT-49. It can also be found in the Mystery Box in Zombie mode.
Pretty, Pretty Princess is a Horror, formerly one of the sirens of legend.
Porphyry is an unusual female Tremere Gargoyle aligned with the Camarilla. In the modern nights, Porphyry remains enslaved by the Tremere.
Ratkin are wererats, one of the Changing Breeds of the Classic World of Darkness. In the Middle Kingdom, the corresponding term is Shubei (ratlike scoundrels) or Shukuei (Rat Demons).
The PM63 is a weapon appearing as a submachine gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and as a pistol in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.
Razor, born as Gary Stapleton, is a crazy violent Malkavian of the 11th generation, and one of the leading Anarchs within Washington, D.C..
Ratkyd is a thirteenth generation Hecata vampire and a neonate.

Sir Rafael de la Vega was a mortal Dark Age Knight who joined the Order of the Poor Knights of the Passion of the Cross of Acre. He was Delgado's lieutenant. He pursues after Silverfur, but falls to the effect of her Gift and attacks anyone close to him in a berserk fury. After harming three pilgrims, it was enough to convince the Poor Knights that the lieutenant was insane and "possessed".
The PSG1 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops.
Rafiq ibn Haroun is the Lasombra Prince of Lucena, Spain, during the Shadow Reconquista period.

Ramon Alvaro is an eleventh generation Tremere Rio de Janeiro, and the sire of Almiro Suarez. He Embraced Almiro, under Regent Karl Johansen's orders, to help their coterie track a local Kindred cult, with a more modern insight.
Rakhama was a Salubri Healer that resided in Constantinople during the Dark Ages.

The (or PzKpfw II) is a second generation light-tank deployed by the German Wehrmacht during World War II. It saw widespread service across all fronts. It is featured in Call of Duty 2 and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

River-Spirits, in Neolithic times, grew from beings hateful of humanity into partners of whatever settlement was nearby. The spirits were willing to provide warnings for those that venerated them, and were known to wed humans for a time. The children of these unions were more likely to Awaken as Water-Wise.

Rocia is a seventh generation Tremere Gargoyle, created from a Salubri during the 12th century by Goratrix. She participated in the Gargoyle Revolt and Embraced the ancient ghoul Ferox, as a sign of gratitude for his help in the rebellion.
Rilwan is a Caitiff Obayifo, a blood-drinking witch based in Lagos.

The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was first seen in the Survival Mode trailer in the hands of enemy Juggernauts.

Saatha, commonly known as Lowly Saatha, was a particularly cunning Setite during the days of Rome. Disguised as a slave boy, he infiltrated the Imperial Court and encouraged various Emperors to act on their vices, having been blamed for the excesses of Nero, Caligula, and Caracalla. As he was ready to lower himself to the deepest level of humanity, something his Cainite rivals would deem too shameful to attempt, he was able to exert influence where they failed. After Rome fell to the Visigoths, Saatah disappeared, but resurfaced later in the courts of the Moors, again as a slave boy. Some Followers of Set even believe that he is still active these nights, preparing the world for Set's return.

Rosamund of Islington was an eighth-generation Toreador of stunning beauty who acted as ambassador for the Courts of Love. She is the signature character of her clan during the Dark Ages, when she became romantically involved with Lord Jürgen von Verden.

1 Rosa Hernandez, also known as Rose, is a Gangrel resident of Chicago.Rosa harbors a deep hatred for the Lupines and will stop at nothing to destroy them. Determined, she resumes her studies, delving into knowledge about werewolves with the same dedication she once devoted to researching mundane animals during her mortal days.

The P.E.S. (Pressurized External Suit) is a piece of equipment on the Zombies map Moon. It gives players the ability to survive in areas that are void of oxygen on the Moon, much like a space suit. It is available in every Air Lock throughout the map. It takes the same inventory slot as the Hacker device. The P.E.S suits are mentioned in the map Der Eisendrache, in an audio reel. In the Deceptio fracture, following the absence of Ultimis Richtofen due to the events in The Giant facility, Doctor Groph says the suits were placed due to increasing atmosphere of paranoia.
A Sachamama enjoys spending its days slithering through the undergrowth, ready to chase down any creature it perceives as a potential meal.
Samantha Gregory is a Nidmuzug, also known as 'The Unclean'. The Nidmuzug are wereroaches.

Satanis is the Kerberos who rules the Underworld Dominion of Gehenna. Taking the form of an enormous man wearing a leather mask shaped like a goat's head, Satanis's existence is one of suffering. His skin is covered in boiling grease, while his mask's eye holes gouge into his sockets. In order to distract from his pain, Satanis tortures the souls imprisoned within Gehenna.
The PP-90M1 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Sees-by-Stars is a Metis Stargazer Ragabash who knows Kailindo. He appears in Rage.
Shawnda Dorrit, also known as Shawnda Dirrot, is a 12th generation Brujah antitribu and priscus of the Manhattan Sabbat.
Shejana is a Ravnos who currently makes her home in Chicago.
The PM-9 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Shandy is a Homid Ahroun War Leader, a respected member of the Fianna living in the Brazilian Amazon.
Shamit ibn Yasir is an eighth generation Toreador and the Prince of Aden, in Yemen, during the Medieval era.
Shifa is a twelfth generation Nosferatu of the London Camarilla. She is a silent killer.
The Pak 43 gun (Panzerabwehrkanone 43) is a German anti-tank gun appearing in Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 3 and Call of Duty: World at War.
The founder of the Winter Court was a changeling called Snowflake John.
Skinny Danifa was a ninth generation Tzimisce koldun of the Chalice of Osseous Delights, and the sire of Zaljko Petrescu.

Spreaders are a type of Spectre seen in Orpheus. They are found only in Spectral hives, and are capable of building and reshaping the hive walls using ghostly gauze. Using harvested ghosts, they soften the gauze with their touch and spread it over the walls of the hive, or reshape it into forms they need. They cannot build over powerful positive Artifacts, however, and usually must help work the hive away from or around these items.
The PDW-57 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Strike Team and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Sophie "Short-Kut" Goodwyn is a Wolf-blooded from Northeast Philadelphia.

The St. Ladre Nosferatu, also known as the Leper Knights, is a Nosferatu family and order of hospitaller knights (originated from the Order of St. Ladre) within the ruling Trinity of Constantinople, although they were never fully recognized by Michael the Patriarch. They were the brood of Fra' Gerard and Fra' Raymond and were known to use the old crusader tunnels below the city to move around. They follow the Road of Heaven.
Suzi is a Spirit and Familiar to an Orphan mage known as Cindi.
The Peacekeeper is a submachine gun featured in the Revolution downloadable content pack for Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

Surarihan is a powerful Ravnos of British India, during the Victorian Age. He held several of the Indian rajas in blood thrall. This power was far more limited than it once was, as the Indians themselves no longer govern their own land.
Taliesin is a legendary Mage from Cymru, the land mortals know as Wales.

Tarantine is an eighth generation Lasombra of the Sabbat, and the sire of Mohammed Al-Muthlim. He was part of a war pack attacking the Anarch Free States in Los Angeles, and was possibly destroyed during their unsuccessful invasion.

The Party Rock Camouflage is a DLC weapon camouflage/skin available for Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is available for anyone who buys the Party Rock Pack for 160 MS Points or $1.99 through PSN. It is most likely inspired by the EDM duo LMFAO's song "Party Rock Anthem".

The woman known only as Director Thetis exists as the centerpoint to the mysterious Project Proteus. She initially proposed the Project to the Æon Council against the better judgment of Project Utopia Director Justin J. Laragione. To his surprise, they approved of her Thetis Proposal. Thetis possesses the genetic predisposition to nova latency, however, she has not awakened, for some unknown reason.
Thurifuge, the Master of Stagnation and Lord of Disease, is a Maeljin Incarna of Lethargg, the Urge Wyrm of Apathy.
The boy is a Baali who appears in the opening vignette of Clanbook: Baali. He seduced and used the abbot Jonathan as an incubator for his insects.

The Paladin Camouflage is a personalization weapon camouflage skin featured in [http://callofduty.wikia.com/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Black_Ops_II Call of Duty: Black Ops II]. This camouflage is available for $2 for PC users and was released for PC users on June 28, 2013 as one of the two fan-voted camouflages, with the other being Cyborg Camouflage. The Paladin Camouflage returns in Call of Duty Online and it's exclusive for the Paladin variant of RPD.
Thomas Reichal is a Silver Fang Philodox who appears in Rage.
Thegri is a renegade Devourer in Los Angeles. Thegri is possessing the body of a mortal known as Luis Alvarez.

Tony was a meth cook and drug addict who attempted to use the car-spirit the '57 Chevy to effect an escape from the police and was subsequently trapped within it. Though he attempted to con a colleague, Javier, into taking his place, Tony only succeeded in getting the both of them digested.

Pack-A-Punch Camouflage is a downloadable weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. This camouflage is available for 1.99 USD on all platforms and also comes with the Pack-A-Punch Pack. It was first released for Xbox 360 on July 23, 2013, 12:30 a.m and subsequently for PS3 and PC on August 22, 2013, 3:50 p.m. It is similar to the Pack-A-Punch skin that appeared in Der Riese from Call of Duty: World at War, which is obtained in Zombies mode through upgrading a gun using the Pack-A-Punch Machine. It can only be used on multiplayer maps on all weapons.

Trowbridge is the cainite Prince of Caernarvon during the Medieval era. The local mortal Baron's advisor was obstructing him from having the Baron store his collection of relics, and as such, Trowbridge had the advisor poisoned to appear insane and lose credit with his master.
Tytalus was a powerful mage, one of the Founders of the Order of Hermes and creator of House Tytalus. Known for being combative and hot-tempered, he drove off or slew many non-Hermetic magi.

The Unbirthed, also called Moon-Flowers, are a type of monstrous shock troop created by the Sabbat, birthed from human corpses infused with the sacrificed vitae of a Thin-blooded or Fledgling vampire. These fledglings are buried, then raised from a mass grave by a ritual, shorn of names or memories.

The Panzersoldat (German: Armoured Soldier), also known as Mech Z is an enemy that appears on the maps Origins, Der Eisendrache and Revelations. It takes the appearance of a zombie in an armored suit, and will jump in from outside the map boundaries using a rocket pack to attack players. First seen in the map Origins, it is armed with a Flamethrower and a giant claw to grapple players. It cannot be distracted with a Monkey Bomb or a G-Strike Beacon. The first Panzersoldat will always spawn in Round 8 unless the player hasn't open the door to No Man's Land yet. If the door was opened after round 8, it will spawn in the next round. The first Panzersoldat will also drop a piece for the Staff of Fire when killed, which is the only way to obtain the piece. Every third round (fourth-fifth in solo) after Round 8 also includes one or more Panzersoldats (only ever one in solo). However, they do not appear in the Crazy Place. The first Panzersoldat of each group in subsequent rounds will drop a random Power-Up. In Der Eisendrache, instead of the gripping arm, the Panzer has a cannon that shoots electric projectiles. The first Panzersoldat will spawn in round 12. It will next spawn every five to six rounds. During the Easter Egg My brother's Keeper, a Panzer will immediately spawn after returning to present time, and also during the Corrupted Keeper boss fight. Furthermore, players can obtain a Panzersoldat Claw Helmet. In Revelations, the Panzersoldat has the same model as in Der Eisen

The Veela are the female Cainites who serve the Cult of Veles. They have a reputation for exceptional savagery. These priestesses of Veles act like Valkyries, choosing which warrior lives and which falls, and they also make fierce warriors and hunters themselves, especially skillful with the bow.
Valborg Crooked-Eye, was an Eighth Generation Gangrel and Queen of Bjarkarey.

Valentina della Torchia was a Lasombra descendant of Aconia Messalina and prince of Ancona, a trading port, during the Dark Medieval. An unashamed pagan and a potent adherent to the Via Voluptarius, she carried on her lineage's tradition of scandalizing her clan.

The Patriot-XM11, or Guided Round, is a precision guided munition, that is used as a secondary weapon on the M1A2 Abrams in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It is only used during the level "Severed Ties", where player can accelerate or detonate the projectile in flight, much like the Valkyrie Rockets from Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II. The Guided Round has a limited fuel supply, so it will automatically detonate if a target isn't hit in five seconds.

Vidal Jarbeaux, also known as The Fox, is one of the Camarilla's top archons and is assigned to the Toreador Justicar. Vidal is a master of disguise and the first Kindred to disguise himself as Rasputin.
Virginie, the Prodigy, is a Sabbat Bishop of Dublin. A completely ruthless diablerist, she has had a meteoric rise within the sect.

Viorica, otherwise known as the Scarlet Witch, is a member of the French Tremere, based in the county of Anjou in France. She is the Regent of Tours's chantry. The cruel French Tremere known as Viorica is the master of the Tours's chantry on behalf of House Tremere. She was given the position by Goratrix himself. Viorica was a childe of the Councilor of France, LeDuc.

The P-06 is a bullpup sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. It is unique in that it fires a rapid three-round burst instead of a single shot. There is a short charge delay from pulling the trigger to the burst firing, making it more difficult to hit moving targets.
Vincetti Marcus Giovanni was a of the Giovanni clan, who authored the Voce del Morte, the Voice of Death.

Veronica Ortega is a Lasombra vampire and Cult of Shalim Apostate. She abandoned the Cult after witnessing the destruction of various cultists by Shalim himself, following their attempt to summon him from the nearby sea's deeps.
Walks-in-Shadows is a metis Theurge Bone Gnawer. She appears in Rage.

The P.A.W.W.S. (Pilotable/Autonomous Walking Weapons System) is a large autonomous bipedal combat robot, or mech, that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. Several P.A.W.W.S. are encountered as enemies in both the campaign and combat immersion modes.
Water Horses, also known as each uisge, kelpies, drowning horses, or huenna sisi, are water-spirits that feed on humanity's fear of water.

Véronique La Cruelle was a ruthless and the Archbishop of Montreal from 1935–1975. She was known to wear a "leather" jacket made from the skin of the Setite Moise, and made "homicidal artwork". The sole survivor of the conflagration which destroyed The Widows' brothel haven in 1907, La Cruelle became archbishop when Kyle Strathcona, her lover, became cardinal. She later vanished during the Sabbat conflict with the local Setite cults and Sangris the Serpent rose to take her place. Unknown to most, Metathiax turned her into one of the bestial thralls he has created in the Montreal sewers. La Cruelle's two Zantosa ghouls were adopted as retainers by Sabrina, while her coat was "gifted" to Muse by Metathiax.
Whiskey Jack (Wisakedjak in Anishinaabe languages) is a Totem of Wisdom.
The Panzersoldat Claw Helmet is an item that is available in Call of Duty: Black Ops III on the Zombies map Der Eisendrache.
Werter is a powerful Scandinavian Gangrel and the unofficial Prince of medieval Uppsala.

Zafar al-Baghdadi was once a noted follower of the Road of Humanity whom dwelled in Baghdad. He was both honorable and thrustworthy, but also cunning and deceptive. His only great flaw that proved to be his undoing was his fear of his own Beast that he regarded as a punishment for his sins. As a result, he used Animalism to sendt it away into others as often as he could. This however, proved to be dangerous as at one time, the host died before Zafar was able to recall his Beast. He immediatly collapsed into Torpor, awakening hundreds years later. Following the death of his Beast, he lived a miserable unlife, unable to hunt or to motivate himself to do anything. When his sire tried to help him by sending her own Beast into him, he erupted into a Frenzy and killed his sire and then departed Baghdad, barely able to contain the rages of this new Beast and dangerously close to Wassail.
Yael is a 9th generation Salubri, childe of Althea of Phillipus. She was a warrior of her clan and companion of the healer Matthias of Bath.
The Peacekeeper MK2 is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and Call of Duty: Mobile.
The daughters born of the Rainbow Serpent, the Yawkyawks are the protectors of the waters and all that dwell within them.
Yuma McKenzie is a powerful Gangrel and the Anarch Baron of Montreal. He maintained peaceful ties with the local Montreal Camarilla.

Zoticus is a Nosferatu knight of the St. Ladre Nosferatu. He supported the escape of the elder Nosferatu Malachite from Constantinople, fighting the Baron's Gangrel, Latin and Lasombra forces along the way, while leading the rear. After the order's captains leave to journey with Malachite, Zoticus takes over the order temporarily in the city.

The Particle Amp is an attachment featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. Any weapon equipped with this attachment will either gain or maintain damage when engaging targets at further distances. It is exclusive to energy-based weapons.

is Roger Rabbit's wife and the tritagonist of the book and movie. In the book, she was an amoral, up-and-coming star and former comic character, over whom her estranged husband, comic strip star Roger Rabbit, obsessed. She is re-imagined in the film as a sultry, but moral, cartoon singer at a Los Angeles supper club called The Ink and Paint Club. She is one of several suspects in the framing of her husband, who is a famous cartoon star. She is voiced by Kathleen Turner. Amy Irving was cast to sing "Why Don't You Do Right?" (a blues song made famous by Peggy Lee) for Jessica's first scene in the movie. Betsy Brantley served as Jessica's performance model. Jessica was based on Lauren Bacall, Rita Hayworth in Gilda (1946), and Veronica Lake (noted for her famous "Peek-A-Boo" hairstyle). She is one of the most famous sex symbols on the animated screen, being compared to that of Betty Boop or Red Hot Riding Hood. She claims to Eddie Valiant, "I'm not bad, I'm just drawn that way," which has become a popular quote. She deeply loves her husband Roger, claiming that he makes her laugh and that he makes a more fitting husband than Goofy. It was said by her animators, that Jessica is so "exuberant", because they wondered how far they could take her behavior without comments from the Walt Disney Studios. After the film, Jessica also appeared in the Roger Rabbit/Baby Herman shorts Tummy Trouble as a nurse, Roller Coaster Rabbit as a damsel in distress, and Trail Mix-Up as a park ranger.

is a cartoon character created in 1928 at Walt Disney Animation Studios. Horace is a tall anthropomorphic black horse and is one of Mickey Mouse's best friends. Characterized as a boastful show-off, Horace served as Mickey's sidekick in Disney's early black-and-white shorts. A common gag in his early appearances was his ability to change at will from being a normal horse to a more human-like character.

"Captain" Cookie is an elite murloc, captain of the Defias juggernaught, and the last boss of Deadmines in normal mode. In Heroic mode, there is one more boss after him. The murloc was using Cookie's Tenderizer to fight, a fun fact, until we learned how many skulls he smashed with. Cookie survived his encounter and went to Talador to make some fine Legion Chili. After meeting his demise at the hands of adventurers, his soul was sent to Maldraxxus where he became an abomination leftover. He can be seen fighting the forces of Deathwingurlugull in Azmerloth.

Particle Beam is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the Erad's Epic Cyclopean variant. It converts the fully-automatic submachine gun into a beam firing weapon in a similar fashion to the Steel Dragon and the EM1 from Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. Because of this, the weapon is given a faster fire rate and a large magazine clip to comprehend this.
"Dragonwing" Dan is the pandaren flight master of Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.
"Captain" Kaftiz is an ethereal self-proclaimed captain of the Consortium located at the Mana Tombs in Terokkar Forest.
Acorn Harvester is a flying squirrel located at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus. Acorns are found nearby.

The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, and Call of Duty: Mobile. Unusable PKMs are also briefly seen in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Aedan Moran is a human flight master located at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown. He was present during Death Rising.

Aerin Stonehand was a female dwarf warrior who was a part of King Magni Bronzebeard's elite guard. She was described as stout and cheerful, and physically being pink-cheeked and muscle toned curvaceous, with her brown hair tied in a long braid running the length of her back.
Advisor Mukkdor is a tauren located at the Darkspear Offensive during the Siege of Orgrimmar. His Healing Totem is behind him.

A Panzerzug (English: ) is a railway train protected with armor. Armored Trains usually include railroad cars armed with artillery and machine guns. The armored train made its first appearance in the campaign of Call of Duty: WWII, and was later included in the multiplayer war map Operation Intercept.

Aeda Brightdawn is a blood elf warlock who came to with the Sunsworn. She joins the Horde adventurer as a follower, and is one of the few followers who can accompany the player through Draenor with her Bodyguard trait.

Agustus Moulaine is a human armor vendor located in the Cathedral Square of the human capital of Stormwind. He owns and runs the Righteous Plates shop, alongside Theresa Moulaine. Their shop can be found just south of the Cathedral of Light. Agustus is responsible for the sale of various mail and plate armor, as well as shields. In the Vision of Stormwind, he is found within his shop, having seemingly killed Theresa Moulaine. He is found channeling void magic on her corpse.

__NOTOC__ Agent Skully is a Forsaken spy from Venomspite located in the New Hearthglen cemetery in the Dragonblight. She is magically disguised as a human of the Scarlet Onslaught using a magic mirror borrowed from Spy Mistress Repine.

The (L/60) (5 cm Panzerabwehrkanone 38 (L/60)) was a German anti-tank gun of 50 mm calibre. It was developed in 1938 by Rheinmetall-Borsig AG. It was a capable gun that remained in service right to the end of World War II. The PaK 38 first appeared in Call of Duty: WWII. Binoculars Pak38 WWII.png|Germans firing PaK 38 guns in the distance.
Agnol is a vrykul ghost located the Field of Fallen Kings in Stormheim.
Airborne Goblin Priest is a goblin priest located in Azshara. He was called by Custer Clubnik with Blessed Flaregun to exorcise his dozer, Margene. The exorcism was "success" and the dozer is free.

Alchemist Pestlezugg is a goblin alchemy vendor located at Gadgetzan in Tanaris. This renowned alchemist sells all kinds of formulas to the better sort of alchemist for a price, because he still is a goblin. He is worried about the presence of silithid around Tanaris and Un'Goro Crater. After finding out what the danger was, he became an opponent of the silithid, ready for a fight with poisons and gases. In addition to his normal supplies, Alchemist Pestlezugg sells and in a limited (1) supply. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
The is a German medium tank that appears in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS).

Alandien is a demon hunter at the Ruins of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley. She is one of the three night elf demon hunters in charge of training new recruits, and was also a mentor of Varedis until he surpassed her abilities. Alandien teaches demon hunter recruits about infiltration. She remarks in her battle against Azaloth she was trained by Illidan himself. She was the first known female demon hunter in-game. Her fellow demon hunter Kayn Sunfury mourns her passing, and holds Altruis the Sufferer responsible for her death.

Alayin Glitterhelm was a high elven mage who murdered an orc far seer to get the Book of Khadgar. He had learned of the book from a friend, who in turn had learned of it from a goblin merchant, who had stayed with the far seer. After his friend met an unfortunate fate, he made his way into the orcs far seer's spirit lodge and killed the orc. Before he finished reading the first lines of the book, he was attacked by a second guardian, a wolf made out of shadows.
Akar the Black was a ghost of an orc blademaster located in . He was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
The P-61 Black Widow is an American night fighter aircraft produced during World War II. The P-61 was effective in its role of night-time combat and reconnaissance.
__NOTOC__ Alaria is a draenei shaman found in Exile's Reach.
__NOTOC__ Allana Swiftglide was a night elf flight master at Windshear Hold in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Alluvanon is a water elemental located at Alluvanon's Delta in Azsuna. Shaman players can interact with it to begin a one-time mini-game, where you need to collect 10 bubbles and return them to Alluvanon—while avoiding the sharks. Successfully completing the mini-game will award you 50 Artifact Power, which does not scale with Artifact Knowledge.
The Paladin HB50 is a straight pull bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.

Corporal Aloysius Millsworth was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Drustvaria, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Alregosa is a blue dragon located at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.
Amarth is a Maldraxxi necromancer and the second boss of the Necrotic Wake.

The PBX Holo 7 Sight is an optical attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It is available to the assault rifles (except the AK-47), submachine guns, shotguns, light machine guns and marksman rifles.
Amish Wildhammer is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon flight master located at the Stair of Destiny in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Amella is a red dragonspawn located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.

Commander Anaris Windwood was a member of the night elf Sentinels and the commander of the Ashenvale region. She was tall and physically powerful, with purple hair and pale blue skin. Her most striking feature, however, was the facial scars she'd received from a troll's raptor. She chose not to have the scars healed, instead proudly referring to them as the "true mark of the soul". What she lacked in beauty, she made up for in ferocity and her attitude towards others, with someone once describing her as having the shooting skills of Shandris Feathermoon and the inspirational skills of a satyr.
Packed Powder is an ammo type available exclusively for all Shotguns in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It helps to increase the gun's damage range but at a cost of aim down sight speed and fire rate.
__NOTOC__ Anchorite Elbadon is a draenei healer located in the Parhelion Plaza of Sunwell Plateau, tending the wounded Shattered Sun Soldiers with Neophyte Narama.

Ancient Swoop is a vulture located in Mulgore and the Stonetalon Mountains. It can also be summoned by Ancient Tauren Talisman.

Andesigos is a blue dragon who was tasked by Malygos to guard the dracthyr in the Forbidden Reach. He wrote Report: Infestation. He was overwhelmed by the toxins from insectoids, and his skeleton lies in the Support Creche.
Antilus the Soarer is a rare mob hippogryph found in Feralas. Only hunters who know the secrets of taming feathermanes can capture him.

Anne Otther is a human death knight captain of the Alliance, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Anne Otther or another random Alliance Captain will spawn each time the Alliance reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.

Overkill Vest is a Vest featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. Overkill Vest increases weapon swap speed and the player can reload while sprinting. If equipped with Quick-Grip Gloves, or Commando Gloves, gain the effects of Marksman Gloves. When equipped with Overkill Vest, the player can have two primary or secondary weapons, but cannot have a Field Upgrade.
Anna Skyspirit is the flight master for Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.

Apothecary Staffron Lerent was a Forsaken apothecary hidden away in the Alterac Mountains behind Ravenholdt Manor, who appeared only during the Love is in the Air event. He created several special fragrances in order to lull unsuspecting users into a state of misguided euphoria. This was all apparently part of a plot to undo both the Horde and the Alliance. His title suggested he worked in the service of Sylvanas, although he was secretly working for the Shadow Council. However, when confronted about it, the ghost of his dead wife, Annalise Lerent came to him, and helped him see the error of his ways. He has since been replaced by the Crown Chemical Company, which operates from Shadowfang Keep during Love is in the Air.

Anuur is a draenei jewelcrafting vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Anuur holds the same stock as Tiffany Cartier in Dalaran. During Death Rising, he defended the area with a mace in his hand.

Aradria Cloudflyer was a night elven expert hippogryph rider, one of the best in Ashenvale. She was tasked by Commander Haldrissa Woodshaper to send a missive to Darnassus and inform Tyrande Whisperwind that the Horde have infiltrated Ashenvale. She and her hippogryph, Windstorm, were struck down en route by Garrosh Hellscream's orcs. She lost the missive and suffered a mortal wound during the assault. The orcs left her for dead assuming she would die from her wounds, yet she prayed to Elune for the strength to complete her mission before passing on. She was rewarded as Parsis, one of Malfurion Stormrage's druids, found her and brought her back to Darnassus, where she was able to relay her message to Tyrande personally, after which she died from her wounds.

It changes the EX1 into a functional marksman weapon by heavily increasing the damage and vital damage it can do. In doing so, it also changes it to a semi-automatic fire mode with a much reduced capacity. It also takes a massive hit to both the recoil and the hip fire accuracy.

Aquarian is a water revenant located at the Splithoof Hold in Thousand Needles. It doused the Ancient Brazier deep inside of Splithoof Hold and Skycaller Vrakthris would like the Sacred Flame returned.

Ash'alah is Tyrande Whisperwind's saber cat. She has been with Tyrande since before the War of the Ancients and can be seen in a piece of art alongside Tyrande as a cub while the young priestess visited with Cenarius, just before the war. It is unknown where Ash'alah was during the war itself, but she nonetheless survived and became Tyrande's life-long companion and battle-mount. Tyrande rode Ash'alah during the Third War, Garrosh's invasion of Ashenvale during the Cataclysm, the occupation of the Temple of the Red Crane in Krasarang Wilds on Pandaria, at the Siege of Orgrimmar, in Val'sharah and Suramar on the Broken Isles during the third invasion of the Burning Legion, and in Darkshore during the Fourth War.

Arwyn Sorrow is a night elf dead shot. Self-renamed after his family died in the Third War, this night elf spent a good month hunting in the desolate areas of Felwood forest, carrying only his bow. He soon got into the habit of shooting everything that moved, as most everything that moved in the sickened forest was intent on doing him harm. Although his eye is sharp and unforgiving, he is quick to judge, sometimes too quick. Although the night elves know he would be an asset to their military, they fear diplomatic upheavals if he shoots someone without considering their affiliation. The night elves send him on unofficial missions to help clear Ashenvale of monsters and intruders, believing that deep in the forest is the best place to keep him. Perhaps time alone will heal his grief.

Attacking from the Shadows is a short story in the World of Warcraft Official Strategy Guide. A rogue named Saslen, is journeying with his companions, Gothara, Wertala, and Sinsear when they decide to attack a camp of quilboars in the Barrens at night. While his friends waited up on a far hill, he had sneaked into group of quilboars, and they could not see him. He then signaled to his companions that there were four quilboars in the camp. The tauren warrior Gothara rushed the camp, she roared, putting wariness into the quilboar, causing them to fight poorly. The troll priest, Wertala chanted the seven troll words for pain, causing one of the quilboars to suffer. The warlock Sinsear sent his voidwalker to attack the enemy. However one of the quilboars was undaunted and began to bring the power of elemental flame from the land. The others were already preoccupied to bring force to the foe. Saslen had his own plan however. He snuck behind the caster, and cut into its back, four times in quick succession. The quilboar turned to look at him with fear in its eyes. The quilboar could not finish its spell, as his words were slurred from the poison the rogue had inflicted. The rogue killed the quilboar with one final cut. The creatures called for assistance, but none were left to heed their cry.

Tidemistress Athissa is a general of Queen Azshara and Tidemistress of the Hatecoil naga. Queen Azshara, former leader of the ancient night elves, rules the naga with supreme authority. Her servants are many, but few can match the fanatical devotion of Athissa. At her queen's command, she is poised to lead a massive naga army into Azsuna, a region rumored to hold a long-lost titan relic of power. Nothing will stand between Athissa and this prize - not the cursed night elf spirits who haunt the land nor the Horde and Alliance forces that are gathering on the Broken Isles.
Attendant Shimmerwing is a faerie located in the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.

Avogadro is a niffen flight master located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern. He has connections to Dragonscale Camp and Obsidian Rest.

Private Pearson was a character featured in Call of Duty 2. He was seen in the Landing Craft en route to the beach during The Battle of Pointe du Hoc. As the player is about to hit the beach, he is hit in the head by enemy fire from the cliffs while he is looking behind him.
Azure Scale-Binder is a blue dragonspawn found in the Nexus.

The Doom Lord Azgoth was an annihilan who dwelled in a citadel on a Burning Legion-controlled world, inhabited by felguards and felbats. At some point, Margrave Akarek and Baroness Draka of the House of Eyes traveled to Azgoth's planet and stole a set of maps from his stronghold. Later, at a point when the Legion's occupation had turned the world's jungles into a dry wasteland, Illidan Stormrage led his Illidari demon hunters in an attack on Azgoth's citadel. During the ensuing battle, Azgoth managed to strike Illidan with his flail. As he was about to finish the demon hunter, Kor'vas Bloodthorn leaped forward and blocked the blow with her warglaive. In response, the annihilan pushed her up against a wall and growled that she smelled "more demon than hunter" and that she would serve the Legion well. Kor'vas simply replied "Never" as Illidan launched himself into the air and stabbed the pit lord in the back with the Twin Blades of Azzinoth. Much like Mannoroth had perished during the Third War, Azgoth instantly died and exploded in a burst of fel fire.
Babagaya Shadowcleft is a gnome warlock trainer located in Ratchet in the Northern Barrens. She summoned imps during the Legion Invasions.

Plot Armor (also known as Magic Bullet Shield, as seen in map scripts) is an informal term referring to a character's unusual ability to survive infinite damage, due to their importance to the story. In the Call of Duty series, this can be seen when certain NPCs such as commanding officers and characters notable to the story can survive normally fatal attacks in combat. They typically stagger at any incoming fire and fall down as if they died when taking enough damage, but will soon get up and resume fighting. Characters without plot armor (such as randomly generated soldiers) can die from any fatal event, including accidental death at the hands of the player. In addition to friendly NPCs with plot armor, certain enemies throughout the series may have plot armor if their actions are significant to the plot.
Azure Tender is a green dragonspawn located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.

Baker Masterson is a human ghost, who is a bread and drink vendor, located at Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands. Bellandra Felstorm is a Forsaken warlock found in Twinspire Keep, in the Jade Forest; she leads the undead forces of the keep, while Dalgan leads the orcs, she later dies after Fractured Forces.

It is a lock-on launcher that is active when playing as the Predator, and it appears to have both high damage and accuracy, and no ammo counter. It is able to lock-on to enemies with the Incog perk. The Predator Self-Destruct is a weapon in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It is only available with the Predator Field Order reward on the map Ruins. The Predator Self-Destruct is the last weapon the Predator has in its arsenal. Upon sustaining enough damage, the player will drop into a Last Stand mode, and will use a device on their left arm to activate its self-destruct. The Predator will then laugh as an explosion similar to the K.E.M. Strike is called in, killing all enemies on the other team. If the Predator continues to take damage from enemies, the K.E.M Strike will detonate prematurely.

Bleeding Hollow Dark Shaman are fel orc dark shaman belonging to the Bleeding Hollow clan who can be found in Hellfire Peninsula.

__NOTOC__ Blightblood Trolls are dire trolls created by Overlord Drakuru. They were originally Captured Drakkari Chieftains, but have been infused with Blight, making them more powerful than they ever could have been before. They are seen chained up in the upper level of Voltarus.
Persian Carpet is a Weapon Camouflage in Call of Duty Online.

.]] Blingtron is the name of a series of robo-unit constructs resembling gem-encrusted mechagnomes. Plated in gold and chrome with a variety of impressive inlaid jewels, these mechanical constructs are known for their endless generosity and gift-giving. The Blingtron line didn't really pick up until the 4000 series hit the vendor shelves. Few remember the Blingtron 3000, but it was an engineering marvel in its own right. When a new series of Blingtron units are released, the older series is considered obsolete and sent to their deaths in bloody gladiatorial arenas. They may be created with planned obsolescence. A Blingtron's generosity circuits don't mature until they have been built to maximum specification. As such, one should not expect any free handouts from them until maturation. Blingtrons are built with several sockets that carry gems. While the Alliance and Horde's forces were occupied with the sabotage of the Dark Portal on alternate Draenor, one Blingtron managed to build a secret vault of riches, guarded by alarm-o-bots and crowd pummelers. Touching a Blingtron's power supply may be enough to kill small critters, such as moles.
Blistering Steamragers are steam elementals found in the Halls of Lightning. They travel in groups together and are accompanied by Unbound Firestorms.

Bloodbeak the Berserker was a powerful wildkin who Samuro, the orcish blademaster, killed in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne as part of Rexxar's campaign in Old Hatreds. Bloodbeak was a vicious beast; having torn apart the orcish village in which Samuro had lived. Samuro swore to hunt down Bloodbeak, and eventually succeeded in doing so, finding the beast in lands near the Coastal Base.
Pink Giftwrap is a weapon camouflage skin in Call of Duty Online somewhat similar to the Kawaii camouflage skin.

.]] :"Every victorious battle empowers our pursuit of vengeance." - Highlord Darion Mograine. Blood Presence is the death knight tanking Presence, available at level 57. While active, the death knight receives increased stamina, a higher armor contribution from gear and decreased damage taken. It also increases threat generation to 900% damage done.

:"Trust me... whatever happened to Loramus, we can fix. The limits of blood magic are still undefined." Bloodmage Lynnore is a blood elf quest giver located in Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands. She is one of the rare users of blood magic.

Bloodmaul Warlocks are ogre magi found in Daggermaw Canyon and Bloodmaul Camp in the Blade's Edge Mountains. They become once becoming neutral with Ogri'la. However, they remain attackable without damaging Ogri'la reputation.
Phantom Camouflage is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

Bloodwarder Stewards are elite blood elven warriors equipped with enchanted greatswords and blood red plate armor. Stewards can tap into the arcane to enter a brief, but terrifying frenzy. They are among Commander Sarannis' personal guard. The Bloodwarders' charge is to defend the main entrance to the Botanica from invasion.

Blue scalebanes are the most elite of the blue dragonspawn, and they represent a small fraction of blue dragonspawn society. These are the leaders, the most powerful spellcasters, and the elders of the blue dragonspawn race. While all blue scalebanes were wyrmkin and flametongues earlier in life, scalebanes are technically a different species, having been transformed by a complicated ritual similar to those undergone by dragons as they mature. Scalebanes are chosen from the best of the lesser ranks, those who demonstrate exceptional leadership as well as combat or magical abilities. While most scalebanes are intellectual, they are still powerfully built for combat, standing 7 feet tall on average. They are trained in the use of all types of weapons and tactics. Many blue scalebanes carry banners representing their draconic patron or matron, such as Azuregos in Azshara or Haleh in Winterspring.

Bodley is a gnome ghost quest giver located at the Blackrock Spire balcony in Blackrock Mountain. He was once part of the same mercenary company as Anthion Harmon, Falrin Treeshaper, and Theldren. Unfortunately, he was killed at Blackrock Spire, and even more unfortunately, he is stuck there in ghost form and nobody can see him. Unless they have the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer, that is.
The Pharo is a four-round burst submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Bom'bay is a jungle troll witch doctor in training located in Sen'jin Village in the orcish starting zone of Durotar. He is the assistant of Master Gadrin who commented that his voodoo is strong. Bom'bay also accompanied the Darkspear Rebellion in retaking of Razor Hill.
Bo the Wind Claimer is a pandaren flight master found at Zouchin Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

Boarton Shadetotem is a tauren rogue trainer found in the Hunter's Hall in Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. According to the Bluffwatchers, Boarton showed up one day and insisted he had been around the whole time. They don't know how he managed to be so quiet with such enormous hooves, but they are sure he can sneak up on anyone.

The Plunger is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III Zombies on the map Der Eisendrache. It deals the same damage as a normal knife. The Plunger can turn into a flammable Plunger, a temporarily upgraded version that is able to kill any kind of Zombie (Panzersoldats included) in one strike. The upgrade is applied simply by killing a Panzersoldat, and lasts one minute, after which the player can upgrade it again.
